indicator_name: Open position of the National Bank's liquidity operations (balance and instruments: deposits, repo, swaps, deposit auctions, notes), monthly average and end of month
description: Открытая позиция по операциям Национального Банка (сальдо и инструменты: депозиты, РЕПО, своп, депозитные аукционы, ноты), в среднем за месяц и на конец месяца
unit: billion KZT (negative = the NBK absorbs liquidity)
methodology: Daily balances 2020-01-05 onward (MPR annexes to 2024-01, the page's JSON from 2023-11-08, identical on the overlap), kept as <ITEM>.AVG (mean of business days) and <ITEM>.EOM (last business day of the month). Items: BALANCE (= the sum of the others), standing facilities DEPOSITS, DIRECT_REPO, REVERSE_REPO, FX_SWAP; open market DEPOSIT_AUCTION, REPO_AUCTION, NOTES; OTHER (swaps with banks and the mortgage organisation, reverse repo with it, loans to banks); CORR_ACCOUNTS (banks' correspondent accounts at the NBK, memo, from 2023-11). The JSON's days are checked against the identity balance = sum of operations. 2026-11-05: BALANCE −8 705.65 (deposit auctions −6 562.75, notes −1 635.2, deposits −507.7).
